PRIVACY

A note about this preview.

The brief tool processes your text within the current page. It does not send the content to a server or save it in cookies or local storage. The tool does not retain the brief after a refresh or language switch.

Only your language preference is saved in your browser’s local storage, so the site can remember Chinese or English. Without a saved choice, the home page uses Chinese for a Chinese-language browser and English otherwise. Direct links keep their language. Switch in the header at any time, or clear site data to remove your choice. This preview has no analytics trackers, third-party fonts or external form service. The hosting service may generate access logs.

Please do not enter sensitive personal information, medical records, credentials or confidential business information. Before a public launch, the privacy policy needs to reflect the actual operator, hosting services and contact details.
